<function=python>
<parameter=code>
r = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':51,'col':21}])
print('result', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward')})
def objs(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        c=n['color']; a=n['pixels']
        if c=='W' and a>20: continue
        if c in ('W','G') and a>=2:
            b=n['boundary']; rr=[q[0] for q in b]; cc=[q[1] for q in b]
            d.setdefault(c,[]).append(((min(rr)+max(rr))//2,(min(cc)+max(cc))//2,a))
        if c=='p' and a>=15:
            b=n['boundary']; rr=[q[0] for q in b]; cc=[q[1] for q in b]
            d['sq']=((min(rr)+max(rr))//2,(min(cc)+max(cc))//2,a)
    return d
print('after', objs(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
